landing.title: Welcome to KaushalPath
landing.subtitle: Discover the right vocational career for you and your family.

consent.title: Data Consent
consent.description: We need your consent to store your profile and assessment data for recommendations.

settings.title: Settings
settings.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete all your data? This cannot be undone.

ask.title: Have a concern? Tap a question
ask.a_cost: For {{career}}, the fee depends on the exact course. We only rank options that fit the budget you set — you can change that in your profile.
ask.a_far: We rank {{career}} higher when a centre is close to your district. Allowing relocation in your profile widens the options.
ask.a_jobs: {{career}} is shown partly on local demand and placement signals from market data. These figures are demo data until real sources are loaded.
ask.a_stable: Stability for {{career}} is judged on demand index and NSQF alignment. You can ask a counsellor to review it for a human opinion.
ask.recorded: Thanks — we've noted this concern so a counsellor can follow up.

room.create_subtitle: Invite your family and a counsellor to decide together, in your language.
room.share_code: Share this code with your family:
room.title: Family Decision Room
room.select_careers: Choose up to 3 careers to compare
room.no_candidates: Finish an assessment first to get careers to compare.
room.override_note_placeholder: Note for the family (recorded in the audit trail)

weights.title: What matters most to each person
weights.help: Slide to weigh each factor for yourself. Values are normalised automatically.
weights.legend: Higher weight means that factor matters more to the person.

compare.title: Side by side
compare.radar_caption: How each option scores on the factors (0–1, higher is better).
compare.why_higher: It ranks highest because {{best}} matters most to your family's weights.
compare.source_note: Every number shows DEMO/real provenance. Hover a factor for its source.

vote.title: Rate each option (1–5)
vote.hint: 1 = not for us, 5 = strongly in favour.

consensus.title: Family consensus
consensus.no_votes: No votes yet. Vote to see the consensus.
consensus.whatif_hint: Move one factor to see the ranking update live.

roadmap.title: Roadmap for {{career}}
roadmap.demo_note: Shown with demo catalogue data until real sources are loaded.
